messages:
sara_sales: FYI customer 'Gamma' on the trial (gamma-trial-42) hit a spend alert but their invoice shows $0 and the usage dashboard shows 0 tokens. they say they made a bunch of requests this afternoon. can we triage? :eyes:

devon_se: Oof. Which alerts fired? spend-alerts or rate-limit?

sara_sales: spend-alerts-email + webhook -> they attached the alert screenshot. no 429s reported on their side, just slow responses then alert.

mike_support: Can you drop their org id? I'll tail logs.

sara_sales: org: org_0xGAMMA, user email: kate@gamma.example, trial credits 500K tokens.

mike_support: I ran `GET /internal/usage?org=org_0xGAMMA&from=2026-03-20&to=2026-03-21` and got an empty array.

ashley_eng: can you paste the service logs for the period? curious if metering events were emitted or filtered out.

mike_support: pasted a snippet:
```
[2026-03-20T15:04:12Z] metering-worker INFO event_received org_id=org_0xGAMMA request_id=req-7a9c type=completion tokens=124
[2026-03-20T15:04:12Z] billing-filter INFO skip_event reason=trial_exclusion tag=gamma-trial
[2026-03-20T15:04:12Z] metering-worker INFO event_ack req-7a9c
```

mike_support: i see a `trial_exclusion` filter hitting. that would drop events from ingestion.

devon_se: hmm we introduced a temporary filter last week to exclude internal test trials from billing ingestion. looks like it matched `gamma-trial` prefix too broadly.

tara_billing: confirming — our filter was `prefix in ["internal-test-", "trial-"]` and the new pipeline did a substring match by mistake. so Gamma matched `trial-` inside `gamma-trial`.

sara_sales: oh wow. customer-facing POC got caught by internal filter. not great.

ashley_eng: quick mitigation: update the filter to anchor to prefix match and reprocess missing events. I'll push a patch to staging then prod if tests pass.

devon_se: for immediate relief we can trigger a one-off backfill for org_0xGAMMA from archived raw logs. `scripts/reconcile_usage --org org_0xGAMMA --from 2026-03-20 --to 2026-03-21`

mike_support: running backfill now. output:
```
> python scripts/reconcile_usage --org org_0xGAMMA --from 2026-03-20 --to 2026-03-21
INFO: found 83 events, applying 83
INFO: tokens accounted: 103,524
INFO: backfill complete
```

tara_billing: after backfill their dashboard shows 103,524 tokens and the spend alert counter resets. invoice still shows $0 because trial credits cover it — but recorded tokens are now visible in billing reports.

sara_sales: called Kate and explained. she was relieved. asked for a post-mortem and assurance this won't happen again.

devon_se: root cause: ambiguous substring matching in the trial exclusion rule. patch: use regex `^trial-` or explicit list; added an integration test to prevent regressions.

ashley_eng: deployed fix to prod at 15:42 UTC, and kicked off daily reconciliations for last 7 days to catch any others.

billing-bot: Invoice update: org_0xGAMMA — usage recorded: 103,524 tokens, charges: $0 (covered by trial credits). Reconciliation job id: rec-20260320-1834.

tara_billing: I'll send a short note to the customer and cc sales with the reconciliation details and a brief apology.

sara_sales: thanks all. please add this to the POC playbook: check trial filter rules when metering anomalies show 0 usage. :thumbsup:

mike_support: logging a follow-up ticket: BILL-4592 (update: linked to internal alert rule).

sara_sales: closing this thread after customer confirmation tomorrow.
